subject: Post-call: SDK quickstart & architecture handoff for embeddings + tool-calling
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acme.com>, Roland Cheng <roland.cheng@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SDK quickstart & architecture handoff for embeddings + tool-calling

Hi Alice / Roland —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed handoff for next steps so we can unblock your PoC with minimal friction. I captured action items, a short SDK quickstart (Python + TypeScript) you can run locally, and some architecture notes around auth, routing, and embeddings/reranking.

Highlights from the call:
- Goal: POC to demonstrate retrieval-augmented generation + reranker for search result sorting, with a side demo of tool-calling for invoice lookups.
- Constraints: on-prem index (self-hosted vector DB), strict API key rotation policy, sub-200ms generation target for short prompts.

Immediate next steps (owners):
1) SDK quickstart run & smoke test — Alice / Roland (customer), target 3/22. Instructions below.
2) Auth design review (Karthik + Dev) — internal pre-flight on 3/19.
3) Routing + fallback policy decision (Marissa) — propose defaults for hosted vs private.
4) Embeddings pipeline sketch & reranker sample (Jordan) — I’ll drop a working sample and the draft arch diagram.

Attachments: redwood-sdk-quickstart.zip (contains sample app, Dockerfile), acme-arch-diagram.pdf (draft).

---- SDK quickstart (local) — Python minimal flow ----
Prereqs: Python 3.10+, pip, Docker (optional). You only need an API key for hosted or local token file for private.

1) Install: pip install redwood-sdk
2) env: export REDWOOD_API_KEY=<<YOUR_API_KEY>>
3) sample run (embeddings + rerank):

from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# embed two documents
docs = ["Alpha product description", "Beta product description"]
embs = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-large', inputs=docs)
# store to your vector DB (example uses in-memory list for smoke test)
# reranker: create pairwise relevance scores
query = "integration SDK setup"
q_emb = client.embeddings.create(model='embed-large', inputs=[query])[0]
# naive cosine rank (example included in quickstart)
print('Similarity scores ready — run reranker sample script in zip')

---- SDK quickstart (TypeScript) ----
Prereqs: Node 18+, npm
1) npm install @redwoodai/sdk
2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=your_key
3) sample snippet:

import { Redwood } from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const embs = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-large', input: ['doc1', 'doc2'] });
console.log(embs);

Security note: For the PoC, use short-lived API keys and rotate. For Private deployment we'll demo KMS-bound service principal auth.

Routing/Model fallback suggestion:
- Primary: local private model pool for latency-sensitive calls (routing by route tag).
- Fallback: hosted smaller-quantized variant if local pool saturated (auto-fallback policy).
- Recommendation: prefix-based caching + KV cache for repeated prefixes.

Please try the quickstart and let us know two things: (1) did the embeddings smoke test run locally? (2) do you have a preferred vector DB we should wire in for the PoC (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate)?

I’ll follow up with the internal tasks and a worked example using your sample invoice tool (tool-calling sample) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Alice Park <alice.park@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: SDK quickstart & architecture handoff for embeddings + tool-calling

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifying Qs before Mar 22 run: 
1) For the on-prem vector DB we plan to use Milvus. Will the sample app in the zip show an example insert/lookup against Milvus or just in-memory?
2) Our security team requires: API calls from our VPC must present a signed JWT that maps to a service principal, not a static key. Is that on your roadmap for the private deployment?
3) For reranking, we want to compare your built-in reranker vs a lightweight logistic ranker trained on our data — is that easy to plug in?

I’ll try the quickstart tonight and report back.

— Alice
CTO, Acme Platform

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SDK quickstart & architecture handoff for embeddings + tool-calling

Alice — great questions. Short answers and owners below: 
1) Milvus: quickstart includes an example Milvus connector (Python) in the "db_connectors/" folder — it's commented but runnable if you have Milvus running locally. We'll swap to your cluster endpoint for the PoC. (owner: Dev)
2) Signed JWT / Service principal: yes — we support mutual TLS and JWT-bound service principals for Private deployments. Karthik will lead the design session to map your SSO/JWKS. (owner: Karthik)
3) Reranker swap: the SDK exposes a ranker interface; you can plug an external scorer (your logistic model) easily — we included a small adapter example in the zip. (owner: Jordan / Dev for wiring)

I’ve scheduled a 30-min auth design call for 2026-03-19 10:00 AM PT (invite sent). Please let us know if that works.

Also attaching a short curl example for embeddings + reranker invocation against hosted API for quick verification:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":["doc a","doc b"]}'

# Then POST to reranker endpoint with candidate IDs (see quickstart for payload):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-small","query":"integration SDK","candidates":[{"id":"1","embedding":...}]}'

I'll confirm the PoC Milvus endpoint and share the mapped adapter by tomorrow.

Cheers,
Jordan
